the study of the central benzodiazepam receptors in man, with the aim to develop a new method of assessment of the receptor occupancy in vivo by means of PET and [11C]-flumazenil.

zolpidem is a full agonist at the central benzodiazepam receptor, and that the hypnotic effect of zolpiden is achieved by a moderate receptor occupancy (about 25%).
